The parameters actively… 95764370 modification-in-the-chemical-bath-deposition-apparatus,-growth-and-characterization-of-cds-semiconducting-thin-films-for-photovoltaic-applications modification chemical bath deposition apparatus growth characterization cds Abstract In this paper, growth and characterization o Modification in the chemical bath deposition apparatus, growth and characterization of CdS semiconducting thin films for photovoltaic applications Abstract In this paper, growth and characterization of CdS thin films by Chemical Bath Deposition (CBD) technique using the reaction between CdCl 2 , (NH 2 ) 2 CS and NH 3 in an aqueous solution has been reported. The parameters actively involved in the process of deposition have been identified. A commonly available CBD system has been sucessfully modified to obtain the precious control over the pH of the solution at 90°C during the deposition and studies have been made to understand the fundamental parameters like concentrations of the solution, pH and temperature of the solution involved in the chemical bath deposition of CdS.
